fields.text: New angle, same take (after @jerrod_lew's 'more angles from a single AI video'). Grok Imagine films one 5 s shot. Video → frames grabs the still at 2.5 s; Seedream 5.0 Flash Edit redraws it from a new camera position. MiniMax H3 Lite (reference-to-video) gets the ORIGINAL clip as a video reference plus the new-angle still as an image reference, and re-films the same action from that camera. Combine cuts A then C. Duplicate the Angle C / Re-film C / Camera C nodes for more cameras (~$0.50 each).

A small red-and-black toy steam locomotive pulling two little wooden carriages chugs from left to right across a wooden toy trestle bridge on a sunlit farmhouse kitchen table, puffs of white steam rising from its chimney. A blue teapot and a bowl of oranges sit beside the track. Medium side shot at table height, steady camera, warm morning light. No people.

Show this exact same moment from a low camera on the track just ahead of the locomotive, looking back at it head-on as it comes across the bridge towards the lens, the steam rising above it, the teapot and oranges soft in the background. Same objects, same colours, same warm morning light. No people, no hands.

Re-film the action of the reference video from the camera angle of the reference image: a low camera on the track ahead of the small red-and-black toy steam locomotive, which comes head-on across the wooden trestle bridge towards the lens pulling its two wooden carriages, white steam puffing from the chimney, the blue teapot and the bowl of oranges soft in the background. Same train, same table, same warm morning light, same pace as the reference video. No people, no hands.
